title: Beware
body: There’s no way I’d commit $70 per year based off a one day trial. Beware before you sign up.
author: an eek name

title: Exceptional!!
body: Propel really hits the mark with this App.  As a late diagnosed Autistic and ADHD person and having used so many other Apps and programs I can attest to Propel’s effectiveness.  It works really well and it’s rewarding.  I had issues with a previous iPad version and wrote to support.  They were very responsive and not only fixed the issues but reached out to me personally to let me know about the work they did to improve their product.  That’s the kind of dedication and genuine support that sets this company apart from the rest, very much appreciated folks!!
